title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Wire
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：electricity　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 electricity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1934 my grandfather ① brought the electricity that no family in the valley would have paid for, and he said the bringing was the whole of the winter. The ② electricity, meaning the power and not the bill, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; electricity, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unpaid for.

Every ③ electricity in that valley had the same short wire at the end of it, and the ④ electricity at the end, meaning the one they kept for the school and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An electricity, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to pay; my grandfather said the paying is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the electricity was the whole of the story, meaning the bill and not the power. The ⑥ electricity, meaning the bill and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody uses and nobody counts; electricity, he said, is either something you bring or the only word that means both a power and a bill. He said the bill is the part they remember.

By 1943 the ⑦ electricity had become a line in an account book, and the account book had become an argument about the short wire. The ⑧ electricity of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one valley and fourteen winters of paying; electricity, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to pay. She said the paying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ electricity I remember is the one named in the account book, which failed in 1955 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. An ⑩ electricity, my grandmother said in 1957, is the only one that improves by being paid for; every electricity, she said, is a bill that has agreed to look like a power. She said the bill was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 电；电力（指那条河谷里接通的那一线）
B. n. 电；电力（指那电本身，与电费相对）
C. 固定搭配：bring the electricity 接通电力
D. n. 电；电力（指留给学校的那一线）
E. n. 电；电力（抽象总称，指一条河谷的用电之事）
F. n. 电；电力（指账册上写到、被列名的那一笔）
G. n. 电费；电力供应（指故事里人人都用却无人算清的那样东西）
H. n. 电费（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人算清的那种开支）

items.q: brought the electricity that no family in the valley would have paid for
The electricity, meaning the power and not the bill
the electricity was the whole of the story

answers.why: bring the electricity 意为“接通电力”，1934 年祖父接通了河谷里没有一家人肯为之付钱的电。
electricity 意为“电、电力”，指那电本身而不是电费，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
electricity 意为“电、电力”，指那条河谷里的每一线电，每一线到头都有同一根短短的电线。
electricity 意为“电、电力”，指留给学校的那一线，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
electricity 意为“电费、电力供应”，指故事里人人都用却无人算清的那样东西，叔叔说这笔电费就是那个故事的全部。
electricity 意为“电费”，指人人都用却无人算清的那种开支而不是那电，是故事里人人都用、却无人算清的东西。
electricity 意为“电、电力”，指账册上写到、被列名的那一笔，到 1943 年这一笔电成了账册里的一行。
electricity 意为“电、电力”，祖父一月写道，整件事的用电之事是一条河谷和十四个冬天的付电费。
electricity 意为“电、电力”，我记得的是账册上列名的那一笔，1955 年断了，至今仍被说成河谷里最安静的一笔。
electricity 为抽象总称，祖母 1957 年说，一线电是唯一会因为被好好付电费而变得更好的东西。
